page.overview:
Who is Hidari?

Compared to the other self-aware Human God Trees, Hidari is taciturn and rarely expresses himself, feeling the most unclear of his identity. Because he was created from Sasuke's chakra, his newly formed individual identity is shaped by Sasuke's emotions and bonds. His feelings are especially stimulated by thoughts of Sasuke's daughter, Sarada Uchiha, and as a result of his instinct to consume chakra being altered by his evolution, he has chosen her as the target he wishes to devour. Hidari has also been shown to be a lunar individual with little to no sense of reality. This is particularly noticeable when he seriously asked if Naruto Uzumaki was in the library or when he didn't even realised his role as an invader, asking Jura why Konoha-nin were interfering with them before asking the same question to the shinobi.

As Hidari continued to explore his own personal nature, he came to find a liking for cats. Also, while still finding compassion for others disgusting, he does have measure of like knowing that Jura cares about him.

Hidari strongly resembles Sasuke, but lacks eyebrows and hair. He is tall and well-built in frame, with talon feet, which had 5 digits, unlike the other self-aware Human God Trees. Like the other self-aware Human God Trees he wears clothing made from Claw Marks, including a long, black, studded cloak with pale yellow lining and a hood that's cut and draped over his left eye to resemble Sasuke's fringe bangs. He also wears oversized baggy black pants and a studded black arm guard on his left forearm. Though he otherwise appears human, he possesses a pair of purple Rinnegan.

Being a sentient Human God Tree, Hidari is a dangerous being, considered to be a monster with power well-above his own creator Code, as he could pressure Boruto, despite his Ōtsutsuki prowess.
